scopeResults.tests: Accepted, with two departures from the wording. The architect asked for two two-process tests. c63149d0 adds three tests in comment_mention_takeover_test.go: claimant on an issue with no route, an ask-thread reply reaching its follower, and a primary-document author. They run one Dispatch server on real Postgres against the take-over fake listener, not the cmd/dispatch multiprocess harness. The double copy is decided by one process (the mention's pre-commit resolution against the outbox's route on the same event), so a second process adds nothing to the path. Each failed first: the implementer's red log on the merged code before the predicate, and the tester's throwaway mutation dropping sessionRoutes, both give 'session s1 received the comment 2 times, want once'. The 'reply in an agent's thread' that the merge put at risk is the ask-thread reply (no reply_to). A reply_to thread was already in the wait before #2366, so a test of it could not fail first.

keyFindings.description: main's #2323 (merged 19:56Z) added 0136_dashboard_assets. This PR's 0136_message_delivery_urgency shares version 0136, and pgmigrate refuses two migrations with one version (internal/pgmigrate/set.go:138: 'migrations %s share version %d ... renumber the rest to the next free numbers on main'). The merged tree would fail the store's migration guard, and envoy-dispatch would not boot. GitHub shows no conflict because the file names differ. Merge main forward and renumber this PR's four migrations above main's highest (0137-0140 today), with every in-file name and every code, doc and changelog-fragment reference.
